name: Ottery
title: Wright
examine: Woke with clever hands and no patience, and broke three benches teaching the one the other. The shelf indoors keeps every waker's first mangled craft.
lines: Bench answers to anyone. Bring it a log and see.
My first craft was a stool with two legs. It's on the shelf. Humility, going spare.
The furnace is lit when the crag's been generous. Copper and tin make bronze, and bronze makes everything.
